summary: A snapshot of the standardization state of protocols used in the Internet as of October 2, 2003. It lists official protocol standards and Best Current Practice RFCs and is not a complete index. It was designated STD 1. It is historic and was replaced by RFC 3700.

eli5.summary: This is a list showing which rules had official status on one day in 2003. Later editions replaced it, so it is only history now.
